notes.title: Update 2 for Windows and Linux
notes.notes:
Some bugs were fixed:

 Fixed the crash when the user name had special characters
 Fixed the issue with the "Toggle Crouch" option in the options menu

Also, we added a custom launch option to disable vibration

notes.title: Update 1
notes.notes:
Some bugs were fixed:

    Fail to launch on certain Mac computers.
    A crash at the beginning in few Windows computers.
    The controls menu interface had a minor bug.
A glitch of random blocks on the walls on computers with Geforce 9xx series.

Also, we added few custom launch options.
